answer: Basefold proves with FRI over small fields, so the verifier's work stays tiny. A farm needs 549 separate Basefold proofs, since each one is bound to its own instance. The FRI transcript is verified by anyone, and no trusted setup is required. The pulse check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the juniper trail in the ledger makes the basalt cost visible to everyone.
